about: The Prospector's own sounds. The voice ("Autocraft Prospector", made with Voice Design, eleven_ttv_v3) is a sharp, clipped mining engineer on his helmet radio; its lines go through comm.py for the electronic edge. Ids match the game's sound names (sfx/<name>_<n>).

entries.text: [crisp, over a helmet radio] Rig's warm. Where do you want me?
[clipped, dry] Hard hat's on. Point me at the rock.
[quick, a little sardonic] New shift, same dirt. Let's get to it.
[sharp, matter-of-fact] Torch is charged, boss. I'm on the clock.
[sudden pained shout, cut off] Suit's breached—aagh!
[panicked, then a scream] I'm going down—!

entries.prompt: heavy industrial mining drill grinding into hard crystal rock, steady mechanical whine and gritty rattle, close up
pneumatic rock drill chattering against dense stardust ore, servo motor hum, gravel crumbling
power mining drill biting into glassy crystal, high grinding screech over a low motor drone
plasma arc welder buzzing and crackling on thick steel plate, sizzling sparks, steady
electric arc welding torch hissing and popping against metal, spitting sparks
industrial welding torch with an electric hum, crackle and sizzle on a metal hull
heavy chunks of crystal ore dropped into a steel cargo hopper, one metallic clunk with a short rattle
load of rock ore dumped onto a metal chute, heavy thud and clatter
mechanical claw releasing ore chunks into a metal bin, clank and rattle
small mechanical walker suit exploding, sharp metallic burst with scattering debris
compact machine explosion, crunch of metal and a short fiery pop, debris falling
small power armor blowing up, electrical crackle into a punchy explosion
